what_each_new_part_touches: pin-blue-A's axle end goes into bracket-L's cross hole
pin-red-A's pin end goes into bracket-L's round hole~

pin-blue-A: sticking up out of bracket-L, free end open
pin-red-A: sticking out to the side of bracket-L, free end open

why.problem_solved: Starts the left corner post of the gearbox housing.
why.why_these_parts: The elbow bracket has only one round hole and one cross hole; a friction peg in each turns those into two usable mounting studs at right angles, so the beam and the frame's bottom corner can both attach here later.
why.sets_up_for_later: pin-blue-A's free end takes the 7-hole beam in step 3; pin-red-A's free end is the frame's open bottom corner (not reached again in this 11-step booklet, so it stays as a stub in this model as built).

review_note: The parts box doesn't say which hole each peg goes in; bracket-L only has one of each hole type so the fit is forced, but hole1 is marked ~ since the round-hole/cross-hole split is read from the render, not confirmed by a close-up. The top-right '2x' callout on this booklet page shows a finished corner unit with a black axle sticking out, which looks like step 2's hub-B module, not this one -- it's read here as a forward preview of 'this general corner shape appears twice in the model' (once from this step, once from step 2's different parts), not a literal second build of this exact step. Worth Dennis double-checking against the PDF directly.
